sourceAssembly.thicknessDirection: Panel normal rotates with leaf angle; backing is exactly six world pixels behind each native face.

limitation: Native planar component assembly under a top-down elevation projection. Expanded transparent canvas padding preserves readable upright surfaces without changing the logical 2x1/1x2 footprint. Constant physical dimensions and floor hinges are verified; this is not a newly rendered volumetric shading simulation. Gameplay and occupied landing behavior remain owned by the existing project.
